title: ScoredSignal
description: System 1 (scoring) -> scored-signals -> consumed by S3 gate intake (Task 09). signal_id is the dedup key. FLAT message, no envelope. additionalProperties is false, so a field name not listed here is DLQ'd, not ignored — producer and consumer must agree on the exact spelling.

strategy_key.description: optional human name, e.g. 'nnfx_backtrader'. Informational; the gate keys on strategy_id.

model_score.description: Gatekeeper probability, or NULL when the champion does not know this strategy and refused to score it (S1-NOTICE-2026-08-17 §5). NULL is 'unscored', never 'scored zero' — the gate branches on it at Layer P; it must never be coerced to a number.

threshold_applied.description: The score threshold the producer applied, or NULL when unscored.

scoring_status.description: Explicit scoring provenance. Optional: when absent it is derived from model_score (null => unscored).

selection_basis.description: How this strategy earned its place in the live map. 'qualified' cleared every gate by measurement; 'designated' means a human published it DESPITE failing one. Any other value — including absent — is unknown, and unknown is never permissive: Layer P rejects it. Deliberately NOT in 'required': a missing basis must produce an auditable REJECTED decision row, not a silent DLQ.

gate_failures.description: The gates a 'designated' strategy failed, e.g. ['OOS=46.35mo < 60mo']. Logged with the decision; not itself decided on.

granularity.description: 'D' and 'D1' both mean the daily bar and are normalised to 'D' at intake.

atr.description: ATR in price units on the signal's granularity

producer.description: Which system built and published this message, e.g. 'system-1'. Added 2026-08-28 as System 3's condition on its ADR-001 approval: once inference may run on System 2, 'who produced this' stops being inferable from the topic alone. OPTIONAL for now and required later — see the transition note on 'drill'.

bundle_id.description: The model-set id this signal was produced from, e.g. '2026-08-24T10-08-20Z-cb697b59_gk-d614163c'. Lets a decision be traced to the exact checksummed artifact set a consumer downloaded, rather than to a wall-clock time. System 1 already carries this internally as model_set_id.

drill.description: TRUE means this is a rehearsal message: process it through the full risk path, but stop before any irreversible broker action. Absent or false means a real signal. Added 2026-08-28 — before this the contract was additionalProperties:false with no drill field, so a drill flag could not be carried at all and a rehearsal was INDISTINGUISHABLE from a live order. STATE (2026-08-29, S2-REPLY-2026-08-29): Systems 2 and 3 accept all three fields and System 2 honours 'drill' by stopping immediately before the broker submit, after order construction, its §7.2 last-line validation and its backup guard — so a drill removes the last step, never a check, and does not consume the idempotency key. System 1 stamps all three on every message from 2026-08-29, including real ones: 'absent' is read as a REAL order, and that fail-safe reading is only unambiguous while the flag is always present. TRANSITION: the three stay optional until one real drill has completed after a Sunday open. The safe order differs by direction of change — widening an additionalProperties:false consumer is CONSUMER-ACCEPTS-FIRST (done), promoting a field to 'required' is PRODUCER-EMITS-FIRST (in progress). Getting the first one backwards on 2026-08-28 is what caused bb51a35.
